nom: RMS Beauty Kakadu Clean Cleansing Gel

avis.titre: My New Favorite Face Cleaning Product
avis.texte: I never thought I'd replace my face cleaning serum until I used the RMS Kakadu Cleaning Gell. Its smooth texture leaves my face feeling clean, soft and radiant. And it smells fantastic too! Never thought I'd switch from my old cleanser but I did.

I have been using the Cleansing gel for over a year, it really gets your face clean, especially after using the tinted sun cover-up It's not drying, which is important. It's just thorough not only that one bottle lasts a long time so it's also a very good value.

Oh I absolutely LOVE this cleanser combination! First I use the Coconut Clean Cleansing Balm, then finish with this Kakadu Clean Cleansing Gel. My face never feels dry or tight and it's so refreshing! My complexion has never felt better!
Best gel to foam cleaners ever. Leaves my face clean feeling.
I love this! My face feels refreshed, clean and smooth. Highly recommend it .
Love this new Kakadu Clean Cleanser Gel! The scent smells fresh, blends easily, and light and refreshing! It leaves my face feeling soft and cleans well!

I am on my second bottle of the Kakadu Clean Cleansing Gel and I really love it. It removes all of my makeup without stripping my skin. I follow the cleanser with a serum and that's it. I don't need a heavy moisturizer (unless it is winter). My skin looks clean and clear all the time. The consistency of the gel is light and very lightly foamy. I typically lather the gel in my hands with a little water and apply to my dry face to remove makeup. I get that squeaky clean feeling without any tightness. I am a fan for life!

Part of my nightly routine along with the kakadu cleansing balm . The cleanser is very mild and effectively removes makeup while leaving my face clean and feeling moisturized. I love all my RMS products. I have pretty much all of them.
Great product! Leaves my skin feeling refreshed and looking smooth. Wonderful smell too!
I love this cleanser. It's so light and refreshing. Fragrance in a product is so important to me. I love the citrus scent. This does not dry out your skin like other products.
Kelsi clean cleansing gel smells so good & my face feels nice & clean after using it. A friend told me about the product & how much she liked it.
This is very nourishing and does not strip my skin of moisture. Takes everything off. Good stuff!

I wanted to love this product but it missed the mark! It didn't take my makeup off at all! I even cleansed three times and still had makeup on. I see some reviews mention that it foams up. I'm confused because mine doesn't foam up at all! And I need three pumps each time I was my face. Not worth the price. I'm happy it didn't breakout my face but I need something that is going to work!

I officially trust RMS with my sensitive skin. My skin is so reactive, and this cleansing gel does precisely what I hoped it would. It does not lather with my Foreo tool, but has a delightful gelly texture that glides over my skin while it cleanses. My skin feels clean, but not stripped after use. I have not had a cleanser before that feels like it is nourishing my skin, it is quite a new and wonderful experience. Lastly, the bottle is large and heavy, which I personally enjoy. I love the tones RMS uses in their skincare packaging- they are calming and lovely. The pump is A+!
Creamy gel texture. My face feels fresh, bright and clean after using. Good for hot humid summer day to gently cleanse away oils and impurities. I like the very light scent.

avis.titre: Fresh and clean not tight and dry
avis.texte: Kakadu clean cleansing gel has a foam which is great. I love that it takes of my makeup without leaving my skin feeling fresh and moisturized not tight and dry. And as usual I love that it's a clean product and that it's packaged in glass. :smiley:🩷
Love how my skin feels after using this wonderful product. Nice size of bottle with product.
Love this cleanser! It's light, smells wonder and last longer than most cleansers.

avis.titre: Keeps my skin moist and glowing
avis.texte: Best cleanser i have found in a long time. My skin no longer feels tight after I was it am and pm. Fabulous formulation. Thanks Rose Marie!
Love this! You don't need much. Face feels soft after washing.
I love this cleanser. It cleans without making your face feel dry or tight. It's the one I reach for most days. Other days I use coconut balm.

I am always hesitant with gel cleansers due to my dry skin, but this cleanser leaves my skin so clean without the tightness ! Perfect compliment to the cleansing balm ! It's double cleanse perfection !!

Love this cleanser! I have sensitive skin, and this makes it feel soft and silky without being greasy. This has a nicely muted citrusy scent. Even though I have mature skin, it can be acne prone. This cleanser cleans effectively while leaving my skin dewy.
I like this,gentle,cleansing gel. I love the fact that it is clean.

Love the light mint scent, and the light gel texture. I don't use it in conjunction with the balm- that's just too much. But I have used it on its own to cleanse my skin at the days end. I tend to reach for the balm before this, but do like it!
I really like this cleansing gel. It removes my makeup and leaves my skin feeling refreshed, not dry and tight.
Beautiful gel cleanser with a subtle natural scent- cleanses really nicely with a nice sturdy glass bottle. Great for sensitive skin!
I love gel cleansers and this one helped me face feel very clean and soft~
This cleansing gel is great and easy to use. My skin feels clean, but not tight and dry.

The cleansing gel soothes my irritated skin . I enjoy the way it makes my face feels less tight. It's always my go to face wash. With the combination of the oils and cream, it's for prepping for my final step. My face is looking healthier!

Love this cleanser- refreshing and "clean" feeling with a pleasant and light scent. Feels gentle and none stripping. Also love the packaging- very nice heavy weight and expensive feeling dispenser that doesn't make a mess. Pleasure to use!

avis.titre: Second time ordering this cleanser. . . . . very
avis.texte: Second time ordering this cleanser. . . . . very gentle on my sensitive skin and removes eye make-up very well. . . . just wish it was alittle cheaper. . . . . .

Gentle yet cleans so well! It feels sinking on my skin and does not leave it dry. You only need a little so it lasts a long time. I love this product! Now I'd love RMS to come out with a gentle scrub to go with it!

I really enjoy this cleanser! It's kind of a slippery gel that gently foams but doesn't strip the skin. I use it daily when I don't have a ton of makeup on but do a cleansing balm prior when I have a full face. The packaging is very luxe too :)
I like this wash. It's light and foams up a bit with water. It makes my skin feel clean and hydrated, not dry. Would recommend.
Wonderful Gel Cleanser! All natural and refreshing on my skin- smells great and leaves my face clean and feeling so good!

Literally the best cleanser I have ever used. Doesn't hurt my eyes when I use it. No burning. So gentle on my face. Leaves it feeling actually clean and even hydrated. I love it so much I got me a second bottle before I got half way down so I was sure I wouldn't run out.

avis.titre: I've finally found the perfect facial cleansing duo!
avis.texte: It leaves my skin feeling clean, but not tight. I can tell that I've washed all my makeup and the rest of my day off completely. I start with the coconut oil cleansing balm to remove my skincare, spf & makeup. Then follow with the cleansing gel. It's the perfect combo to renew & refresh my canvas.

Love this new cleaning gel. I have very dry, aging skin. This product consistently takes all my makeup off and leaves my skin moist and glowing. I have changed my skin regime to all RMS products. A new loyal user!
I like the light gel to foam texture. It rinses off easily and face feels clean but not tight. Highly recommended.
The Kakadu cleaning gel feels so silky on my skin. Removes all of my eye makeup and doesn't leave my skin feeling tight afterwards . So glad I tried this product. Thank you RMS Beauty!

Wonderful light face wash. My skin feels great after I use it. Nice packaging, too. I bought the smaller size for travel & it's perfect. Another bonus for me, is there's no strong fragrance !! Highly recommend 😊
This is a nice cleanser, great to travel with in your makeup bag!

I bought this three weeks ago to work with my coconut cleansing balm that i love & have been using for a year. So I wanted to try the double cleansing routine, but ever since I started using it my face has been more red and breaking out. So I gave it a little time to see if maybe it was just cleaning out my pores. But my skin feels drier now than ever. Just wondering if anyone else has had this issue with this cleaners?
Doesn't leave residue but face Doesn't feel tingly clean either

I recently got this cleanser to try in my Step 2 cleanse. I purchased it in the bundle promo with the Coconut cleansing balm which I had already been using. I REALLY like this cleanser! It has a fresh scent, great thin gel consistency and feels great! My skin feels soft, smooth and well hydrated. This past year, I've been struggling with sensitivity issues with my aging skin :rolling_eyes:. The combination of the coconut clean cleansing balm followed by this cleansing gel has been very therapeutic for my skin. I hope it continues to work well for me as we head into summer. I highly recommend this 2 Step cleansing combo! Give it a go!
Nice cleaning gel, gentle but effective at removing makeup Leaves skin feeling fresh and clean
Just love the effortless cleansing, with soothing gentle properties that leave skin feeling clean, fresh and ready for day or night prep.
I like this a lot. Leaves skin feeling very clean but soft and not dry.

I really enjoy this cleansing gel! I use it after the cleansing balm and my skin feels clean but never stripped. I have been using this for about 6 weeks and my skin has never felt so smooth! I attribute that to the combination of all of Rose Marie's products 🥰
Been searching for a gel cleanser for a while. This one is fantastic. Smells good, glass container, makes my skin feel soft, clean and fresh!

This was literally my favorite gift I received this Christmas. With other cleansers I have tried, I have to rinse and rinse and rinse. I don't understand why, but this cleanser rinses away soooo easily. It thoroughly removes all of my makeup and my skin feels absolutely fantastic after I use it. I will never use another cleanser!
I really like this cleanser. My skin feels happy after each use.

I have tried every different type and kind of cleanser under the sun, but I felt like I would never find one that would make my unbearably, uncomfortably dry skin feel good. The experience starts with an absolutely gorgeous glass bottle, tinted with blue, and a white cap that makes you feel like you're sitting next to the ocean. It has a very light and pleasant scent. It dispenses with ease and has the perfect amount of slip in it, so it feels fantastic when you are applying it, and it creates a really nice foam, which I need. It leaves my skin feeling completely clean, but not stripped and dehydrated. I just finished my first bottle, and I used it so far down that I ended up shaking out the last bit of it like an old ketchup bottle to get every last drop. This will be my cleanser for life.
Excellent cleaning gel! Light and fresh. I use the coconut oil cleanse cream at night and the Kakadu cleansing gel in the morning.

avis.titre: Makes me want to wash my face
avis.texte: I love to wash my face now I love to wash my face with this product It is wonderful

This is so bubbly and cleanses well without making my skin feel tight. It does have a bit of scent to it. I felt a slight tingle while cleaning, but it didn't burn my eyes. I have reactive, combination skin. I love the glass bottle and the ingredients are impressive. I also love that it comes in travel size.
The Kakadu cleanser is my favorite! it's just wonderful on the skin. It cleanses nicely and with using the face cloth to exfoliate a bit it's wonderful. The skin feels cleansed and moisturized.
Was super shocked when I tried this product to lift my face feeling cleaning refreshed as well as squeaky clean.
I would say this is my favorite cleanser! Easy to use, one squirt and it lathers up well! Feels lightweight and refreshening. Of course the clean ingredients also are very important to me!
My new favorite cleanser. Love the way it starts as a gel and then develops into a nice foamy cleanser. My face felt so clean after using the cleansing balm followed by this gel-to-foam cleanser.

I was skeptical of this at first because I usually just go for a natural coconut oil cleanse for my eyes makeup and water for my face, since my skin is dry and I don't want to strip it. This feels as light as a feather and does not dry out my skin! I'm sold!
Wonder light fresh smell. Cool and refreshing on the skin. Cleans off makeup without stripping the skin. Skin is left looking dewy and youthful. I use it nightly as part of my skin routine

avis.titre: Great second step after coconut cleansing balm
avis.texte: Smells great and my white washcloth is totally white when I use this preceded by the amazing coconut cleansing balm. I love the balm so much I've never tried the cleansing gel alone!
Love this face wash. Excellent in removing makeup and leaving your sling feeling like glass.

avis.titre: Love love love this my favorite
avis.texte: This is one of my very favorite products from RMS I just love watching my face. I look forward to watching my face because of this.

I use a lot of retinol products on my skin that leave me feeling tight and dry. I always double cleanse and this is the second step in my cleansing routine. I can't believe how much better my skin feels and looks since using this gel formula. It's super hydrating and my makeup goes on beautifully.

avis.titre: Very nice cleanser that keeps my face soft
avis.texte: I purchased a travel size of this product to try it out. I recently used it in Utah where it was very cold and very dry. It cleansed my face well and never left it feeling tight or dry. It helped me keep my skin moisturizer in a tough winter climate.

Love, love, love this cleanser. It is so gentle, yet removes oil from my first cleanse. I have dry, mature, thin skin and live in the high desert. So I usually steer clear of gel cleansers, but this one is lovely and doesn't dry out my skin. It smells fresh--almost like a gin and tonic, if that makes sense. I guess I would call it herbal-citrus. Unlike the SuperSerum, which seemed to disappear before my eyes, this bottle of cleanser is lasting forever. Sometimes I'll add a little bit of finely ground rice powder to it for a gentle cleansing exfoliation. Amazing. This one's a keeper.
This stuff is sooo refreshing! I love how the product foams up, it feels so nice! Ever since switching to rms products my skin is the best ever.

I love love love this. I wash my face with this each night after after first using the cleansing balm. I start my morning with it as well followed by the oil and moisturizer. Perfect combination. Thank you rms beauty for making a wonderful skincare line . My 67 year old cancer survivor skin loves all of your skincare products .

This product is absolutely perfect! Melts away every bit of makeup and whatever has collected on your skin from the day and/or night. Delivery system makes it easy to use without waste. And finally, leaves your skin so clean feeling and soft.
This is the best facial cleanser I have ever used. Only 1 pump cleanses so well without drying my skin. It's so pleasant to use! I love and recommend it!
The best cleanser I've ever used! My skin is radiant and so incredibly soft after using it. I love it!

avis.titre: This one's going to replace my other cleansers!
avis.texte: This cleanser is different than any I use. It's silky smooth and light feeling, and it takes just the smallest amount! It leaves the skin feeling weightlessly moisturized. I usually have to change cleansers between summer skin and winter skin, but I think this one is going to replace those and be useful all year round. So happy I tried this one! I do use it after removing my make up with the raw coconut oil and for the record, my skin is very sensitive.
This cleanser is mild and gentle and it doesn't make your skin tight after each wash. I have purchased a third one since then.

Absolutely love this cleansing gel. I have mature skin (over 60) and it is part of my evening routine. (I use the RMS Coconut Clean Cleansing balm in the am as well as first wash in the pm to remove makeup) I love how this cleansing gel gently exfoliates- my skin feels incredibly smooth -almost a glass finish without drying or feeling a residue. Just clean healthy skin!

avis.titre: Every face needs this cleansing gel!
avis.texte: What can I say? Ibises this cleansing gel daily, including after I use the coconut cream cleansing balm or straight up coconut oil cleanser. It makes my face feel SO wonderful and smells great, too!
Love it and use it as a second part of cleansing with the coconut cream.
Love this product. Leaves my face feeling so clean and fresh.
Excellent cleaner. I use it every night. Great for removing makeup. A bottle lasts a long time.
Best cleansing ever! Easy too use and you dnot need a lot of product for it to do its job. Love it. Alreadyy purchased my second bottle.

I was afraid this cleanser would dry out my bone dry, mature skin but I was pleasantly surprised by it! Not only did it not dry out my skin, but as a gel, it has good slip to it! I double cleanse so I only need my cleansers to cleanse, not remove makeup, and this fit the bill! No obnoxious fragrance just a good, basic cleanser, definitely recommend it!

It smells so good! Like a light fresh scent. I love that it comes in a glass bottle and that it's heavy duty. I accidentally dropped it in the shower and it was fine. I use a cold cream first to remove my makeup and then I use two pumps of this cleanser and I'm all set. Very pleased, would recommend!
This is my second and final cleansing at night, like none I have ever used before. Light, gentle, and non drying. My skin has stayed 100% clear an powerless!

Love this stuff! I've been developing my favorite more natural products over the years. And for skin care, I've always been an avid mad hippie girl. But I've upgraded some of those products to RMS. And this face wash is one of my favorites. Mad hippies face is great. But it always felt like there was a little bit of an oily film left on my face. Which my skin looked great. So I wasn't complaining. However, I love the "cleanâ€ feel this face wash gives after using it. My go to is cleansing my face with coconut oil, wiping it off. Then washing my face with this. My skin feels great afterwards!
This cleansing gel is the perfect follow up to the cleansing balm. My skin feels great after using this product!

avis.titre: Great cleansing gel with out drying out your skin.
avis.texte: I am at the end of my second cleansing gel and purchased a third that is in the wings. Because I live in the desert it is hot in the summer and windy the whole year. This gel after the cleansing balm is perfect for my mature 71 year old dry skin.

I have super sensitive skin and have tried every cleanser; most aggravate my rosacea or just don't get my face clean. I found this one to be terrific. I use the new cleansing balm too if it's been a heavy makeup day, with this as a double cleanse. If you're comparing cleansers among clean brands, this one is a real winner.
I use the kakadu gel cleanser routinely on my face, leaving it ready for serums and moisturizer. I also use it after the cleansing cream if I have a lot of makeup to remove. Excellent combination!
Luxurious! Love the natural scent. Face feels clean and not tight or dry.

So glad I decided to try this cleansing gel! It has become my regular morning and night time routine, I sometimes use it with the cleansing balm as well (another great product). There is no color to this cleansing gel and I appreciate that this doesn't make my face feel tight.
Love this product. It removes everything and leaves your skin and creamy!
Top choice cleanser, gently removes makeup and never drying. Excellent ingredients

avis.titre: Might be my new holy grail
avis.texte: 10/10 no notes. Smells great. Glass bottle. No dryness or irritation. I just finished a bottle. One pump a night works for me but I don't wear heavy make up. Picture of just washed no make up. I'm 35.

Love it! Removes makeup without drying out my 60+ skin. I love that it is a safe product. I am using RMS Beauty for most all of my beauty products. No more trendy testing. I am able to pass those by without a thought.

avis.titre: Not good for my sensitive skin
avis.texte: Soft, cushiony, gently foaming, effective for part 2 of a deeper cleanse or on its own on humid mornings as a skin degreaser. Used alone at night, this cleansing gel does not completely remove non-waterproof makeup. I wonder if it's removing my mineral sunscreen, and it leaves my sensitive skin feeling tight. I had hoped to change my skincare completely over to RMS Beauty. But I prefer my skincare to contain no added fragrance, and this cleanser is loaded with scented essential oils. Unfortunately EOs can make my skin hyper sensitive over time (itching, burning, redness, rosacea flush).

avis.titre: Does what it says but made my skin very dry
avis.texte: Really wanted to love this since I love my RMS makeup but unfortunately this caused my skin to become very dry and tight after a few days use. Had to discontinue. Product had a nice fragrance, good lather, took my make up off easily and completely. Really wished it would have worked for me. Guessing I'm just very sensitive to an ingredient in the formula.
This is perfect when I want something a little lighter to clean my skin. Still incredibly gentle and effective!

Only 2 pumps completely cover and clean my face. I sometimes use it after the Coconut Clean Cleansing Balm and sometimes by itself. It truly makes your skin feel clean and refreshed without feeling greasy or oily.

I love everything about this cleansing gel. I use it alone, or along with the coconut balm to remove makeup. Either way, it feels great, cleanses well, is not at all oily, and is also good for sensitive skin. It is very refreshing!
10 Stars. I love the clean refreshing feeling and the way my skin feels after using the Balm followed by Kakadu Cleansing Gel
It works, even with my sensitivities. Tingles a bit, but leaves my skin cool and clear, with no redness.
I love the cleansing cream and cleansing gel so much. I use both when I have makeup to remove, and the gel to just refresh my skin. Love RMS products and have been using for several years.
I just love anything containing the KaKadu. It has transformed my skin. The cleaning gel makes my skin feel so clean with non-drying feel to my face
My go to every day face wash. Cleans my face very well leaving it feeling soft & refreshing.
Awesome cleansing gel! Leaves no residue, no skin tightness. Love it and definitely will replenish

I love this product. I have rosacea and struggle fining cleansers that don't irritate and add to additional breakouts. This is the first cleanser I've used for an extended time without a flare. I will continue this forever! Thank you for this wonderful product!
I absolutely love this Cleanser! Smells wonderful and leaves my skin soft and hydrated. Will definitely rebuy.
I like it, just for sure use the balm first to cut through sunscreen.
Clean non fragrant non drying qualify cleanser. Good quality ingredients.

I was very surprised at how much I liked this cleansing gel. I usually go towards the natural products just like this and I have my tried and true, but this is a wonderful cleanser does not dry out my skin and I'm very happy with it and would definitely order it again when I'm out . It is a very generous size and will last for a while no complaints here.

Cleans well. The long plastic tube dispenser is very awkward which is why only three stars. I don't know what to do with it. Let drops fall on my hand? Wipe the tube across my cheek?As far as cleaning its five stars.
I love everything about this cleanser. From the container, the subtle aroma, to how it performs on my skin is what I need in a cleanser. This one is a winner!
Absolutely love this cleansing gel! It leaves my face but not dry. Love it paired with the cleansing balm,
